<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false" >
  <entity name="new_cmamembershipdetail" >
    <attribute name="new_contact" />
    <attribute name="new_categoryproductid" />
    <attribute name="new_divisionreference" />
    <attribute name="new_membershipyear" />
    <attribute name="new_expirydate" />
    <attribute name="new_divassocaccountid" />
    <filter>
      <condition attribute="new_expirydate" operator="this-year" />
      <condition attribute="new_status" operator="eq" value="100000000" />
    </filter>
    <order attribute="new_divassocaccountid" />
    <link-entity name="contact" from="contactid" to="new_contact" link-type="inner" alias="contact" >
      <attribute name="firstname" />
      <attribute name="birthdate" />
      <attribute name="lastname" />
      <attribute name="fullname" />
      <attribute name="new_contact_id" />
      <filter>
        <condition attribute="new_deathdate" operator="null" />
      </filter>
    </link-entity>
    <link-entity name="product" from="productid" to="new_categoryproductid" link-type="inner" alias="product" >
      <filter>
        <condition attribute="productnumber" operator="in" >
          <value>00000263</value>
          <value>000040</value>
          <value>00000156</value>
          <value>000023</value>
          <value>000055</value>
          <value>000054</value>
          <value>000051</value>
        </condition>
      </filter>
    </link-entity>
    <link-entity name="account" from="accountid" to="new_divassocaccountid" link-type="inner" alias="account" >
      <attribute name="new_ptmacode" />
      <filter>
        <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
      </filter>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>

<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical">
  <entity name="account">
    <attribute name="name" />
    <attribute name="accountid" />
    <attribute name="new_frenchname" />
    <attribute name="new_englishname" />
    <attribute name="new_enableptmadirectmembership" />
    <attribute name="new_account_id" />
    <attribute name="parentaccountid" />
    <attribute name="new_satcampus" />
    <attribute name="new_collegelocation" />

    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
      <condition attribute="new_satcampus" operator="eq" value="0" />
    </filter>
    <link-entity name="new_accounttype" from="new_accounttypeid" to="new_accounttypeid" visible="false" link-type="inner" alias="a_type">

        <condition attribute="new_accounttype_id" operator="in">

      <attribute name="adx_name" />

        <condition attribute="adx_name" operator="eq" value="Published" />
      </filter>
    </link-entity>
    <link-entity name="new_accounttype" from="new_accounttypeid" to="new_accountsubtypeid" visible="false" link-type="outer" alias="subtype">
      <attribute name="new_name" />
      <attribute name="new_accounttype_id" />
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>
